_comment: Curated text corrections applied to the BUILT data (see tools/text_fixes.py). Every entry is a defect confirmed against the source during the content audit. Two kinds: 'extraction' — the PDF says the right thing but the text layer breaks it (a word split across a line break, a lost hyphen); and 'source' — the official PDF itself carries the typo, and we deliberately diverge from it so readers are not taught an error. Each fix must match at least once or the build warns, so a stale rule is never left rotting here. Keep 'find' long enough to be unambiguous.

_dropDuplicateLead_comment: A bold sub-heading the parser folded into the paragraph that follows it, so the word renders twice ('Errata Errata will be added...'). Listed per language; the leading bold run is dropped ONLY when the text right after it repeats the very same word, so a genuine bold lead-in is never touched. This cannot be a find/replace above: the duplication straddles two runs.
